entries.b6ca02091075ef63: This is a single business covering the whole company, engaged in the research and development, procurement, manufacturing and sale of prescription drugs and over-the-counter drugs. Within this, prescription drugs are the core area in which the company places particular emphasis on research and development, with oncology, immunology and inflammation, and neurology as its priority areas. As of March 31, 2026, the company and 28 subsidiaries conducted this business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥515.8 billion (up 5.9% year on year). In Japan, the company sells products including the cancer treatment "Opdivo", and overseas, Deciphera, a US company acquired in 2024, sells products including the gastrointestinal stromal tumor treatment "Qinlock". Because the reportable segment is a single segment, figures are not broken down by segment.
